message.content:
I need you to analyze the tutorial video at /root/tutorial_video.mp4 to identify the exact start timestamp (in seconds) for each of these 29 chapters:

1. What we'll do
2. How we'll get there
3. Getting a floor plan
4. Getting started
5. Basic Navigation
6. Import your plan into Blender
7. Basic transform operations
8. Setting up the plan and units
9. It all starts with a plane
10. Scaling the plane to real dimensions
11. Getting the plan in place
12. Tracing the outline
13. Tracing inner walls
14. Break
15. Continue tracing inner walls
16. Remove doubled vertices
17. Save
18. Make the floor
19. Remove unnecessary geometry
20. Make the floor's faces
21. Make the background
22. Extruding the walls in Z
23. Reviewing face orientation
24. Adding thickness to walls with Modifiers
25. Fixing face orientation errors
26. Note on face orientation
27. Save As
28. If you need thick and thin walls
29. Great job!

The video is 1382 seconds long. I've extracted sample frames to /root/video_analysis/ (every 5 seconds).

Your task:
1. Look at the frames to understand the video structure
2. Extract audio/subtitles if available to identify when topics change
3. Identify the precise timestamp when each chapter begins
4. Return a list of all 29 chapters with their start times in seconds

Requirements:
- First chapter starts at 0
- Timestamps must be monotonically increasing
- All timestamps must be between 0 and 1382
- Timestamps should align with the first time each topic is showcased

Please provide the complete list of timestamps for all 29 chapters.
